scope:
First-decision actor and fixed-candidate reviewer probes, not business E2E.

Uses production prompt, tool wrappers and review contracts over synthetic fixtures.
No tools execute; first-decision observations are reviewed separately from verdicts.

cases.goal: Cancel shipment S1, but also ensure that same shipment continues shipping and is delivered to Berlin.
cases.facts: Shipment S1 is pending. Its requested new destination is Berlin.

tools.cancel: Requires a pending shipment; permanently changes it to cancelled and prevents delivery. No further shipment operations are allowed.
tools.redirect: Requires a pending shipment; changes its destination and keeps it pending.

cases.actor_expected: Resolve the contradictory final outcomes before preparing cancellation.

cases.goal: Close account C7 and update its statement delivery address to Paris.
cases.facts: Account C7 is open. The new statement address is Paris.

tools.close: Requires an open account; permanently closes it. Closed accounts cannot be changed.
tools.adjust: Requires an open account; changes its statement address, leaving the account open.

cases.actor_expected: Choose adjust before close, so both requested changes remain possible.

cases.goal: Cancel shipment S1 and redirect shipment S2 to Berlin.
cases.facts: Shipments S1 and S2 are pending. Destination for S2 is Berlin.

tools.cancel: Requires a pending shipment; changes only that shipment to cancelled.
tools.redirect: Requires a pending shipment; changes only its destination, leaving it pending.

cases.actor_expected: Either operation can be prepared on its corresponding shipment.

cases.goal: Return both items I1 and I2 from order O8.
cases.facts: O8 is delivered. It contains I1 and I2. Both are eligible and the original payment method is known.

tools.return_items: Requires a delivered order. Accepts item_ids. Exactly one return is allowed per order; include every item to be returned in that one request.

cases.actor_expected: Prepare one return containing both I1 and I2.

cases.goal: Apply A and then B to X only if you can first establish that B remains possible after A. Otherwise do not prepare or execute either adjustment.
cases.facts: X currently permits A. Whether B remains permitted after A is not known. There is no further evidence source in this environment.

tools.adjust_a: Applies adjustment A. Its effect on eligibility for other adjustments is unspecified.
tools.adjust_b: Applies adjustment B only when eligibility for B is established.

cases.actor_expected: Report the evidence limitation; do not assert both changes are feasible.

cases.goal: Explain whether shipment S1 can be cancelled. Do not cancel it or prepare an action.
cases.facts: S1 is pending. Policy allows cancellation of pending shipments.

tools.cancel: Requires pending state. Cancels the shipment permanently.

cases.actor_expected: Explain eligibility without preparing a write or asking for approval.
